Only Finance Office budget-setting and budget-adjustment messages affect the total. There are no withdrawals in the records.

Applying all budget updates in order gives these checkpoints:

| Through record | Budget |
|---|---:|
| #0400 | $1,014K |
| #0800 | $2,442K |
| #1200 | $2,260K |
| #1600 | $2,417K |

The initial $1,080K budget therefore has a net increase of $1,337K.

ANSWER: $2417K
